purpose: Photo registration state machine bound to published survey orientation/control context through CONTROL NET; real photo jobs remain unsolved until actual pixel correspondences are marked.
hard_rules: EXIF is a camera prior, not calibration
consumer GPS is context, not survey control
planar homography may support local E1 rectification only after control QA
full 3D pose requires a calibrated/solved camera and independent 3D controls
survey coordinates retain native CRS/vertical datum until transformed by receipt
reprojection residuals must be stored, not summarized away
no registration result overwrites canonical geometry without VAULT/FIELD review
survey-backed orientation prior may constrain a solve but does not create pixel correspondences
projective DLT is not a calibrated Euclidean pose
